title.zh: 乌克兰央行反对现行加密法案：担忧货币主权，要求终审前修订
title.en: 乌克兰央行反对现行加密法案：担忧货币主权，要求终审前修订

current_state.zh: Ukraine's central bank refused to support the current crypto legalization bill and urged lawmakers to amend it before final passage, citing monetary-sovereignty, stablecoin/e-money, and market-access monopoly risks.
current_state.en: Ukraine's central bank refused to support the current crypto legalization bill and urged lawmakers to amend it before final passage, citing monetary-sovereignty, stablecoin/e-money, and market-access monopoly risks.
